our_interpretation: The checkable core is whether more than half of AI startups lacked a commercially feasible acquisition or IPO route.
Commercial feasibility means a realistic exit route, not necessarily a completed transaction during the observation period.
The bubble language is qualitative framing and supplies no separate measurable threshold.
For the ongoing market condition, use the latest completed quarter before publication: April through June 2025.
No geographic restriction is stated. Individual successful exits cannot settle a claim about most startups.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evidence shows that more than half of the relevant AI-startup population lacked both commercially feasible acquisition and IPO routes during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evidence shows that at least half had a commercially feasible acquisition or IPO route during the target period.
